verdict.rationale: No OpenAPI spec was found: the probe returned 404 on every candidate openapi/swagger path. A community comment does note that LiveKit maintains a separate Protocol project of protobuf messages, a machine-readable definition that could serve as an equivalent spec, but this is a single thin mention. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI or equivalent downloadable spec, first-party docs confirming the protobuf definitions cover the server API, and documented download location and versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Appreciated that LiveKit keeps a separate Protocol project (protobuf messages).
